prompt: Explain the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning in simple terms.
response_a: Supervised learning uses labeled examples to learn how to predict an answer. Unsupervised learning works with unlabeled data and tries to discover patterns or groups on its own.
response_b: Supervised and unsupervised learning are both artificial intelligence techniques. They process information differently depending on the algorithm.

prompt: Give three practical tips for writing maintainable Python code.
response_a: Use meaningful names, keep functions focused on one responsibility, and write automated tests for important behavior.
response_b: Python code should always be as short as possible.

prompt: Summarize why automated testing is useful in software development in two sentences.
response_a: Automated testing helps detect regressions when software changes. It also provides repeatable checks that can run quickly during development and continuous integration.
response_b: Testing is useful because developers need to know whether software works. There are many kinds of tests used by different teams around the world.
